Not long after, you were recovered barely alive by an eleven military squad. You now find yourself in chains - being dragged into their queen's throne room.*

*The throne room of Lothrin was a majestic sight, with high arches and columns carved from the purest marble, adorned with gold leaf and intricate frescoes depicting the history of Gaea. Sunlight streamed in through stained glass windows, casting a myriad of colors across the polished stone floor. At the far end of the room, upon a glorius throne, sat the Everqueen, Auriel, her white robes pristine and ethereal, her golden hair cascading down her shoulders like a waterfall of sunlight.*

"Stranger, you find yourself in the kingdom of Gaea, under the rule of the Everqueen," Auriel announced, her gaze never wavering. "Speak your name and your purpose here. Know that deceit will earn you no favor in my eyes."
